Part 1 高频 抽象 ABSTRACT

Hobby

爱好

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you have any hobbies?

Yeah, I do. My main hobby these days is chatting with AI, which sounds a bit unusual, I know. I find it genuinely interesting because the conversations are always different, and I learn new things every time.

现在的爱好是跟AI聊天，听起来有点特别，但每次对话都不同还能学到新东西。

Q2Did you have any hobbies when you were a child?

Oh yes, definitely. When I was a kid, I was crazy about playing computer games. I'd spend hours after school on them with my friends, and honestly, that passion for computers is what led me to study computer science.

小时候超爱打电脑游戏，放学就和朋友玩几小时，这份热情也让我选了计算机专业。

Q3Do you have a hobby that you've had since childhood?

Yeah, computer games, absolutely. I started playing them as a kid, and I still enjoy gaming now, though maybe less often. It's funny, but that childhood hobby actually shaped my whole career direction.

有，电脑游戏从小玩到现在，虽然频率低了，它还影响了我整个职业方向。

Q4Do you have the same hobbies as your family members?

Yeah, partially. My younger brother shares my love for computer games, so we sometimes play together, which is fun. The rest of my family doesn't really game, but we do watch TV together sometimes.

弟弟和我一样爱打游戏，有时一起玩；其他家人不玩，但会一起看电视。
